notes: Three separate routes. The first runs through أبي (a relation with no name) straight to مسعدة. The other two meet at هارون بن مسلم after «جميعا».
The text writes هارون and مسعدة once after «جميعا», but the first route does not pass through them, so no single shared tail fits all three; the two meeting routes are written in full.
«- رضي اللّه عنهما -» is a blessing and is left out.
